Screenshot 04-victory is a real win, but of day 10 only: the run jumped to day 10 with a prepared mid-game loadout (8 upgrades + 200 honey) and won it under autopilot. The full-run victories (scores 28704-34247, rank S) are from the playtest, not the screenshot run.

Honey economy is generous late-game: a strong run ends with several hundred honey, so the Apiary Market is trivially affordable by days 7-10. Early-game (days 1-4) honey is tight and the choices matter.

This branch is a second, independent implementation of the same HIVEWARDEN brief. The repo's master branch holds a parallel build (commit 32f39b44, quota/timer design with blessings and a Wardwasp enemy, bot-verified 10/10). The two builds differ in design (no-quota days here, no blessings, no Wardwasp) and in verification tooling (autopilot here, node bot there). Do not merge the branches blindly — pick one entry.

controls.E: plant a flower patch (10 honey) — regrows bees and yields honey
controls.Space: smoke puff — repels and calms wasps in a radius (cooldown)
controls.mouse click/hold: direct the swarm to a point

core_mechanic: You are the Warden, a beekeeper defending the hives. The bee swarm is your weapon: click/hold the mouse to direct the swarm to a point — bees sting enemies there, then return to the hive. Bees do not die in combat; the hive regrows them over time and flowers accelerate it. Space blows a smoke puff that repels wasps; E plants a flower patch (10 honey) that regrows bees and yields honey.

enemies.behavior: tiny and quick — chews flowers first, then the hive
the common raider — darts at the hive, stings the warden on contact
big, fast, angry — swats bees out of the air
slow and armored — lays webs that slow the warden and bees
steals honey drops and flees to the edge — catch it first
bursts into three mites when banished

between_days.fork: The Meadow's Fork — choose one road: Wildflower Shrine (pay 20 honey: heal 2 hearts + 4 bees; free +1 heart if broke), Quiet Meadow (no toll: +10 honey + 2 bees), Apiary Market (buy relics and supplies with honey)
between_days.upgrade: after each day, choose 1 of 3 upgrades (12 in the pool)

structure.day_rule: Banish every enemy the day sends. The day ends when the field is clear; a par time sets the time bonus. Lose if the hive is destroyed (HP 0) or the warden falls. Boss days (5, 8, 10) end when the boss is banished.

tagline: your swarm is your weapon; direct the bees through ten days across four meadows
